faqs.q: What is the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range used for?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip Dust Plugs range is a set of plugs that cover or close the open end of a quick coupling half, keeping dirt, grit and moisture out of the coupling while it is disconnected. It is listed with 6 part numbers, in the Indus Dust Caps & Plugs range.

faqs.q: How do I read part number 5659-12 in the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range?
faqs.a: 5659-12 is one part number of the Aeroquip Dust Plugs, and the size table gives the description and size of each one. In the table: 5659-12 is Hydraulic Quick Connect Dust Plug, Vinyl, 3/4 Inch Fitting Size; 5659-10 is Hydraulic Quick Connect Dust Plug, Vinyl, 5/8 Inch Fitting Size; 5659-4 is Hydraulic Quick Connect Dust Plug, Vinyl, 1/4 Inch Fitting Size. faqs.q: Which sizes are in the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip Dust Plugs range is listed in 6 part numbers. For example 5659-12 is Hydraulic Quick Connect Dust Plug, Vinyl, 3/4 Inch Fitting Size and 5659-4 is Hydraulic Quick Connect Dust Plug, Vinyl, 1/4 Inch Fitting Size. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every one.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size from the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range?

faqs.q: What pressure is the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range rated for?

The coupling it sits on sets the working pressure of the line. Tell us if the cover will sit on a line that is pressurised or exposed to heat, and we will check the choice.

faqs.q: What is the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range made from?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip Dust Plugs range is listed in carbon steel and vinyl with a buna n seal. Different part numbers use different materials, so read the item description in the size table for the part you order. faqs.q: Which standard does the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range follow?

What matters is that the cover matches the coupling profile and size, so quote the part number of the coupling half. No test certificate is attached to the listing; tell us the documents your project needs when you ask for a quotation.

faqs.q: What coupling does the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range fit?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip Dust Plugs range fits the coupling half named in the table for each part number, and only that coupling profile and size. Quick couplings only seal and flow at their rating when both halves come from the same interchange profile, so quote the part number of the mating half too, or tell us what it must connect to, and we will confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How do I use the Aeroquip Dust Plugs range on a coupling?

faqs.q: Which standard does the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range follow?
faqs.a: The listing for the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range does not name a standard for the covers themselves. What matters is that the cover matches the coupling profile and size, so quote the part number of the coupling half. No test certificate is attached to the listing; tell us the documents your project needs when you ask for a quotation.

faqs.q: What coupling does the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range fit?
faqs.a: The ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range fits the coupling half named in the table for each part number, and only that coupling profile and size. Quick couplings only seal and flow at their rating when both halves come from the same interchange profile, so quote the part number of the mating half too, or tell us what it must connect to, and we will confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How do I use the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range on a coupling?
faqs.a: Push or screw the cap and plug onto the clean end of the coupling half as soon as it is disconnected, and keep it on until the line is reconnected. Some part numbers come with a chain, tether or lanyard so the cover stays with the machine; check the table. Wipe the coupling face before you remove the cover, so dirt on the cover does not enter the line. See our [guide to dirt ingress in transit and storage](/blog/dirt-ingress-in-transit-and-storage).

faqs.q: What is the difference between the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs and the ZSI-Foster Dust Caps?
faqs.a: The ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs and the [ZSI-Foster Dust Caps](/p/zsi-foster-dust-caps) are separate listings with their own part numbers. The ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs adds fhk, plugs and series to its name. Check the part numbers and sizes in each table against your coupling before ordering.

faqs.q: Where is the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range made and can you export it from Dubai?
faqs.a: The country of origin and HS code for the ZSI-Foster FHK Series Dust Caps And Plugs range are confirmed on the quotation. We ship from Dubai, UAE to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, and can prepare the export documents your customs broker needs.

faqs.q: What is the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range used for?
faqs.a: The ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range is a set of caps and plugs that cover or close the open end of a quick coupling half, keeping dirt, grit and moisture out of the coupling while it is disconnected. It is listed with 4 part numbers, in the Indus Dust Caps & Plugs range.

faqs.q: How do I read part number A04DC-DP in the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range?
faqs.a: A04DC-DP is one part number of the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber, and the size table gives the description and size of each one. In the table: A04DC-DP is Dust Cap and Plug, Rubber, 1/4 In Size; A12DC-DP is Dust Cap and Plug, Rubber, 3/4 In Size; A16DC-DP is Dust Cap and Plug, 1 In Size. Quote the full part number when you order, and the part number of the mating coupling half if you have it.

faqs.q: Which sizes are in the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range?
faqs.a: The ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range is listed in 4 part numbers. For example A04DC-DP is Dust Cap and Plug, Rubber, 1/4 In Size and A16DC-DP is Dust Cap and Plug, 1 In Size. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every one.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size from the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range?
faqs.a: Choose from the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range by the size of the coupling half it must cover, then by its series or interchange profile, because a cap or plug only seals properly on the coupling it was made for. Read the size from the table; for example A12DC-DP is Dust Cap and Plug, Rubber, 3/4 In Size. Our [guide to photographing a fitting for identification](/blog/photographing-a-hydraulic-fitting) shows what to send if you only have the old part.

faqs.q: What pressure is the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range rated for?
faqs.a: A dust cap and plug is a cover, not a pressure-retaining part, and the listing for the ZSI-Foster Plug Dust Caps, Rubber range publishes no pressure rating for it. The coupling it sits on sets the working pressure of the line. Tell us if the cover will sit on a line that is pressurised or exposed to heat, and we will check the choice.
